policy: Use documented ancient place names, or documented modern archaeological site names where the ancient name is unknown. Never invent assembly/market town names. Historical cities and archaeological settlements are distinguished from game-designated administrative seats: assigning a capital or a site to a game polity is not proof of an attested historical capital or contemporary ethnic affiliation. Gazetteer period intervals do not establish continuous occupation in 270 BCE; dating uncertainties are recorded per entry. Preserve real site coordinates; province and polity boundaries are game approximations. Some existing scenario polities cannot be supplied with securely attested 270 BCE cities; their named archaeological seats remain explicitly uncertain abstractions.
